newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well established, compared with Monday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow and demand light to moderate. Seller interest was light to moderate. Offerings light.
Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1250 lbs 2 lds 67.00 Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100 lbs pt ld 66.00
On a carcass basis (weight only), compared with last test on Wednesday, slaughter steers and heifers firm-$1.00 higher.

Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1250 lbs some 106.00 Holstein: (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs no sales. Holsteins: ( grade & weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales
Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1200 lbs 106.00-107.00.
Wk to Date: 2,000 Week Ago: 21,200 Year Ago: 19,200
